subject: Recap & request: VP/CTO intro to secure pilot runway
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@storifytech.com>
Cc: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@storifytech.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: VP/CTO intro to secure pilot runway

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the 40-minute discovery earlier today. Short recap and a clear ask to keep momentum:

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost and tail latency for your customer-facing recommendations engine (p99 latency target ~120ms).
- Current blockers: infra capacity commitments, procurement window, and a single-point architecture decision owned by your CTO.
- Success for pilot: run on 1M monthly active requests with parity on quality and <40% unit cost uplift relative to current baseline.

What we propose next
- Schedule a 30–45m VP/CTO intro + technical run-through (we’ll cover runtime tradeoffs, deployment options — hosted vs dedicated vs private — and a short mutual action plan).
- We’ll share a short runbook and cost/latency scenarios in advance.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 27 Aug, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 28 Aug, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 29 Aug, 09:00–09:45

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (call notes), pricing-outline-v1.xlsx (initial ballpark).

Could you loop in the CTO and the person owning procurement (if different from Emily) and confirm a preferred slot? If none of the above work, happy to propose more.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0198

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@storifytech.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: VP/CTO intro to secure pilot runway

Alex —

Appreciate the clear recap. I’ve looped in Sana (our CTO) and Emily (procurement). A couple quick clarifications before we lock a slot:

1) For the runbook you mentioned, can you include the expected infra footprint (GPU types / node counts) at the 1M MAU pilot level and the fallback plan if latency spikes?
2) On data/security: will the private deployment require any on-prem installs or is it VPC-only?

Tentatively the Wed 28 Aug 14:00 slot looks best for us. Sana — are you available then?

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Product, StorifyTech
D: +1 415-555-2323

Thanks Daniel — looping Sana and Emily here. Quick answers and what we’ll bring on the call:

1) Infra footprint / fallback: we’ll attach a short appendix covering expected GPU types and a conservative node plan for the 1M MAU pilot. Fallback policies: auto-failover to a lower-cost model variant + cross-region reroute for regional spikes.
2) Private deployment options: VPC-first (no on-prem binary required for initial pilot). We can discuss full on-prem packaging later if needed.

Agenda for Wed 28 Aug (30–40m):
- 5m introductions / success criteria (VP/CTO expectations)
- 15m deployment options & latency/cost tradeoffs (runtime + quantization / batching levers)
- 10m mutual action plan & procurement timeline
- 5m next steps / decisions required

Sana — are you ok to confirm Wed 28 Aug 14:00–14:40 PST? If that works we’ll send a calendar invite and share the two attached docs in advance.

Alex
